description: Rede de Cycling da Região Autónoma dos Açores (RAA) is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Secretaria Regional do Turismo, Mobilidade e Infraestruturas / Governo dos Açores. Rede de Cycling da Região Autónoma dos Açores (RAA), tendo como informação complementar a modalidade, a sua distância, duração, grau de dificuldade, e entidade proponente do circuito. Coverage: Secretaria Regional do Turismo, Mobilidade e Infraestruturas / Governo dos Açores. The publisher named on the listing is Secretaria Regional do Turismo, Mobilidade e Infraestruturas / Governo dos Açores. Its keywords include redes-de-transporte, snig-dgterritorio-gov-pt, santa-maria, regional, mountain-bike-xc, acores. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
